title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工~Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction
focus: 以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁~Unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier
summary: 從懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁出發，計算施工期不平衡荷載與墩頂臨時固結，再處理懸臂鋼腱、節塊接縫、懸臂工作車循環、溫度與潛變造成的線形偏差與跨中閉合，最後以伸長量、測量回饋與長期撓度監測驗證，並以 Bendorf 橋、Stolma 橋與 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的成敗對照。~Starting from cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder, compute construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary pier fixity, then handle cantilever tendons, segment joints, the form-traveler cycle, thermal and creep effects on geometry and the midspan closure, and finally verify with elongations, survey feedback and long-term deflection monitoring, contrasting Bendorf, Stolma and the Koror–Babeldaob bridge.

units.anchor: 墩頂變高度箱梁~Haunched box girder at the pier
units.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁~Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder
units.mechanism: 平衡懸臂工法讓每一座橋墩成為一個 T 形構架：節塊由柱頭段向兩側對稱延伸，施工期間整個懸臂只靠墩頂承受負彎矩，彎矩隨懸臂長度的平方增長。因此箱梁在墩頂最深、跨中最淺，底板在墩頂加厚以承受壓力，頂板則容納大量懸臂鋼腱。跨中閉合並張拉連續鋼腱後，結構才轉為連續梁，跨中正彎矩出現；施工期與營運期的內力分布截然不同，設計必須逐階段追蹤。~Balanced-cantilever construction turns each pier into a T-frame: segments grow symmetrically from the pier table, and during construction the whole cantilever is carried by hogging moment at the pier, which grows with the square of the cantilever length. The box girder is therefore deepest at the pier and shallowest at midspan; the bottom slab thickens near the pier to carry compression while the top slab houses many cantilever tendons. Only after midspan closure and continuity tendons does the structure become a continuous girder with sagging moment at midspan, so construction-stage and service-stage force distributions differ completely and the design must track every stage.
units.model: 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取主跨 150 m、懸臂 L = 75 m、平均自重 w = 300 kN/m，M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m。若墩頂梁深取跨度 1/17 ≈ 8.8 m、跨中取 1/45 ≈ 3.3 m，所需懸臂預力約 P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN。數值為教學假設。~Root moment of the cantilever M = w·L²/2. For a 150 m main span, cantilever L = 75 m and average self-weight w = 300 kN/m, M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m. With a pier depth of span/17 ≈ 8.8 m and a midspan depth of span/45 ≈ 3.3 m, the required cantilever prestress is roughly P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析軟體逐一加入節塊、工作車、鋼腱與閉合，輸出每一階段墩頂與各接縫的上下緣應力，與手算 M = wL²/2 及容許應力（施工期頂緣不得出現超過規範的拉應力）比較；同時核對變高度曲線（拋物線或多項式）在每個節塊端點的梁深與圖說一致。~Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction; also check that the haunch curve, parabolic or polynomial, gives the drawing depth at every segment end.
units.failure: 若只以完工後的連續梁模型設計，忽略懸臂階段的負彎矩峰值與施工期鋼腱尚未全部張拉的狀態，墩頂附近頂板可能在懸臂末段出現橫向裂縫，底板則因壓應力過高而壓碎或剝落。~Designing only with the finished continuous-girder model, ignoring the hogging peak of the cantilever stage and the state before all tendons are stressed, can crack the top slab transversely near the pier during the last cantilever segments and overstress the bottom slab in compression until it spalls.
units.misconception: 平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。~A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough.
units.practice: 設計說明書必須列出施工順序假設（節塊長度、工作車重量、張拉時程與閉合順序），並註明承包商若變更順序須重新提送施工階段分析，經設計單位審查同意後方可執行。~The design report must state the assumed construction sequence (segment lengths, traveler weight, stressing times and closure order) and require the contractor to resubmit a construction-stage analysis, reviewed and accepted by the designer, before any change to that sequence.

units.anchor: 墩頂臨時固結~Temporary pier fixity
units.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結~Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity
units.mechanism: 兩側懸臂永遠不會完全平衡：一側節塊先澆、工作車前移時間不同、施工材料堆放不對稱、甚至一個預鑄節塊意外掉落，都會在墩頂產生不平衡彎矩。若永久支承是可滑動或可轉動的，懸臂期間必須用臨時固結把箱梁與墩身鎖成剛接，常見作法是墩頂臨時混凝土墊塊加預力鋼棒錨拉，或在墩旁設臨時支撐塔。分段橋設計規範要求檢核差異自重、施工活載、施工機具與節塊意外釋放等施工荷載組合。~The two cantilevers are never perfectly balanced: one segment is cast first, travelers advance at different times, materials are stacked unevenly, and a precast segment could even be dropped, each creating an unbalanced moment at the pier. If the permanent bearings slide or rotate, the girder must be locked to the pier during cantilevering, usually with temporary concrete blocks plus post-tensioned tie-down bars, or with temporary towers beside the pier. Segmental design provisions require construction load combinations covering differential dead load, construction live load, equipment and accidental release of a segment.
units.model: 一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m；加上一側自重多 2% 的差異荷載 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m，合計 M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m。墩頂兩排臨時墊塊相距 4.0 m、總垂直力 N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN，單排反力 R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN，最小值約 −3,319 kN，表示需錨拉鋼棒。數值為教學假設。~One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m; a 2% differential dead load on one side adds 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m, for M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m. With two rows of temporary blocks 4.0 m apart and N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN, each row carries R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN; the minimum, about −3,319 kN, means tie-down bars are required. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值；懸臂施工期間定期量測兩側懸臂端高程差與墩頂傾斜，若傾斜趨勢與不平衡荷載預測不符，立即停止下一節塊作業。~The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination; bars are verified by both jack gauge pressure and elongation. During cantilevering, survey the level difference between the two tips and the pier-top tilt regularly, and stop work on the next segment if the tilt trend does not match the unbalanced-load prediction.
units.failure: 臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆；墩身在施工期承受的彎矩若未檢核，也可能在墩底出現水平裂縫。~If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising; at best the closure cannot be aligned, at worst the whole T-frame overturns. Pier bending during construction, if not checked, can also crack the pier base horizontally.
units.misconception: 只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。~If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier.
units.practice: 在施工計畫中明訂「最多領先一個節塊」與工地材料堆放區位置，臨時固結的拆除時機（通常在閉合並張拉連續鋼腱之後）列為設計單位簽認的停留點。~The construction plan should state a rule of at most one segment ahead on either side and fix the locations of material stockpiles; the release of temporary fixity, normally after closure and continuity stressing, is a hold point signed off by the designer.

units.anchor: 頂板懸臂鋼腱~Top-slab cantilever tendons
units.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱~Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons
units.mechanism: 每加一對節塊，就在頂板張拉一對懸臂鋼腱，錨定在該節塊端面，使鋼腱數量由懸臂末端往墩頂逐漸累積，正好呼應彎矩向墩頂遞增。閉合後在底板張拉連續鋼腱，錨定在箱內齒塊上，以承受跨中正彎矩；現代設計常再加體外鋼腱，經轉向塊彎折，便於日後檢查與更換。錨碇區承受極大的集中力，需配置抵抗劈裂與爆裂的螺旋筋與格狀鋼筋。~Each new segment pair receives a pair of top-slab cantilever tendons anchored at its end face, so the tendon count accumulates from the tip towards the pier, matching the moment growth. After closure, continuity tendons in the bottom slab, anchored on blisters inside the box, resist midspan sagging moment; modern designs often add external tendons deviated at deviator blocks so they can be inspected and replaced later. Anchorage zones carry huge concentrated forces and need spiral and orthogonal reinforcement against bursting and spalling.
units.model: 以 19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線為一束：A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²，f_pu = 1,860 MPa，千斤頂力 P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN。扣除損失後每束取 3,200 kN，墩頂需要 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 束，約每對節塊增加 2 至 3 束。數值為教學假設。~Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN. Allowing for losses at 3,200 kN per tendon, the pier section needs 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 tendons, roughly 2 to 3 more for each segment pair. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查；錨具與夾片須有系統認證與批次試驗報告，錨碇區混凝土在張拉時必須達到設計規定的最低強度。~Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting; anchors and wedges need system approval and lot test reports, and the anchorage concrete must reach the specified minimum strength before stressing.
units.failure: 錨碇區鋼筋不足或混凝土強度未達就張拉，會在錨墊板後方產生縱向劈裂裂縫，甚至錨具陷入；鋼腱孔道灌漿不實則讓水氣與氯離子沿孔道進入，長期造成鋼絞線腐蝕斷絲，這是體內鋼腱難以檢查的主要隱患。~Insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement or stressing before the concrete reaches strength causes longitudinal splitting behind the bearing plate or even anchor punch-through; voids in duct grout let moisture and chlorides travel along the duct and corrode strands over the years, the main hidden risk of internal tendons that cannot be inspected easily.
units.misconception: 懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。~Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.
units.practice: 鋼腱配置圖要同時標示孔道座標、錨碇編號與張拉順序，並要求承包商在澆置前以孔道通球或通索確認暢通；預留空孔道與錨碇作為未來補強之用，並在竣工圖上清楚標示。~Tendon drawings should show duct coordinates, anchor numbers and stressing order, and the contractor should prove each duct clear with a pig or trial strand before casting; spare ducts and anchorages for future strengthening are provided and clearly marked on the as-built drawings.

units.anchor: 剪力鍵與節塊接縫~Shear keys and segment joints
units.title: 現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫~Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints
units.mechanism: 場鑄平衡懸臂的節塊接縫是施工縫：前一節塊端面打毛、普通鋼筋連續穿過，新混凝土直接澆在舊混凝土上。預鑄平衡懸臂則採匹配澆注：新節塊緊貼前一節塊澆製，使兩者端面完全吻合，安裝時以環氧樹脂接縫與多重剪力鍵傳遞剪力，接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，完全靠預力壓緊。因此預鑄接縫在任何施工與營運階段都不容許拉應力，剪力鍵的幾何與環氧樹脂的擠壓品質直接決定接縫剪力強度。~In cast-in-place balanced cantilevers the segment joint is a construction joint: the previous end face is roughened, ordinary reinforcement runs through, and new concrete is cast against old. Precast balanced cantilevers use match casting: each new segment is cast against the previous one so the faces fit exactly, and at erection epoxy joints and multiple shear keys transfer shear with no continuous reinforcement, held closed only by prestress. Precast joints therefore allow no tension at any construction or service stage, and shear-key geometry and the quality of epoxy squeeze-out govern joint shear strength.
units.model: 環氧接縫固化期間以臨時預力棒維持平均壓應力 0.28 MPa。端面淨面積 8 m² 時，所需壓力 F = 0.28×8×10⁶ N = 2,240 kN；每支 36 mm 鋼棒施加 600 kN，需 2,240/600 ≈ 3.7，取 4 支並對稱配置。數值為教學假設。~While the epoxy cures, temporary bars maintain an average joint compression of 0.28 MPa. For a net face area of 8 m², the required force is F = 0.28×8×10⁶ N = 2,240 kN; at 600 kN per 36 mm bar, 2,240/600 ≈ 3.7, so use 4 bars placed symmetrically. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 場鑄接縫在澆置前檢查打毛深度、清潔與濕潤狀態；預鑄接縫在安裝前做乾接合試拼，確認剪力鍵密合，塗佈環氧後檢查擠出是否沿全周連續，並保存環氧批號、適用時間與環境溫度紀錄，固化試體強度與規格比對。~For cast joints, inspect roughening depth, cleanliness and moisture before casting; for precast joints, do a dry fit before erection to confirm shear-key seating, check that epoxy squeeze-out is continuous around the perimeter, and record epoxy lot, pot life and ambient temperature, comparing cured specimen strength with the specification.
units.failure: 環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道；匹配澆注時若剪力鍵破損仍強行安裝，接縫局部承壓不均，可能在預力張拉時崩角。~Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts; forcing a segment with damaged shear keys into place causes uneven bearing that can spall corners during stressing.
units.misconception: 預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。~The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion.
units.practice: 規格中寫明環氧材料的適用溫度範圍、最長開放時間與最低臨時壓應力；低溫或下雨時停止接縫作業，並由監造在每一接縫完成後簽署檢查紀錄。~The specification should state the epoxy's temperature range, maximum open time and minimum temporary compression; stop jointing in cold or rain, and have the supervising engineer sign an inspection record for every completed joint.

units.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環~Form travelers and the segment cycle
units.mechanism: 場鑄懸臂由懸臂工作車（掛籃）在已完成節塊的端部承托模板與新混凝土，循環為：工作車前移與錨定、調整模板高程、綁紮鋼筋與佈設孔道、澆置、養護、達到張拉強度後張拉懸臂鋼腱、拆模再前移。工作車重量通常約為節塊重量的一半，它本身也是懸臂結構，濕混凝土澆入時會下撓，必須預先抬高模板。整個工期的節奏由混凝土達到張拉強度所需的時間決定。~In cast-in-place cantilevering, a form traveler anchored to the end of the completed segment carries the formwork and fresh concrete. The cycle is: advance and anchor the traveler, set form levels, place reinforcement and ducts, cast, cure, stress the cantilever tendons once the concrete reaches stressing strength, strip and advance again. A traveler often weighs about half a segment and is itself a cantilever that deflects as wet concrete is placed, so forms must be pre-raised. The pace of the whole job is set by how fast the concrete reaches stressing strength.
units.model: 依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。f₂₈ = 50 MPa、張拉需 30 MPa（比值 0.6）：第 I 型水泥 a = 4、b = 0.85，t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 天；早強水泥 a = 2.3、b = 0.92，t ≈ 3.1 天。懸臂 69 m 分為 18 節塊時，每節塊省 1.8 天可縮短約 32 天。數值為教學假設。~ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t). With f₂₈ = 50 MPa and 30 MPa needed for stressing (ratio 0.6), Type I cement (a = 4, b = 0.85) gives t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 days; high-early cement (a = 2.3, b = 0.92) gives t ≈ 3.1 days. With a 69 m cantilever in 18 segments, saving 1.8 days per segment shortens the work by about 32 days. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷；工作車首次使用前做載重試驗（例如以水袋或配重加載至設計荷重），量測撓度與錨定桿受力，建立濕混凝土撓度的修正值。~Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors; before first use, load-test the traveler with water bags or ballast to its design load, measuring deflection and anchor-rod forces to establish the wet-concrete deflection correction.
units.failure: 工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。~If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall; stressing early to save time causes anchorage cracking and excessive creep deflection, leaving only demolition, repair and a re-evaluated geometry.
units.misconception: 掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。~A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry.
units.practice: 工作車的設計、組立、載重試驗與每次前移後的錨定檢查應由專業技師簽認，前移作業列為停留點；每一循環的張拉放行條件（試體強度與錨定檢查）以表單管理，不得口頭放行。~Traveler design, assembly, load test and anchorage check after each advance must be signed by a qualified engineer, with every advance a hold point; release for stressing in each cycle (cylinder strength and anchorage check) is managed by a signed form, never verbally.

units.anchor: 閉合段與預拱線形~Closure segment and camber
units.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合~Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure
units.mechanism: 每一節塊的澆置高程等於完工縱斷面再加上預拱值，預拱抵銷之後所有會發生的變形：後續節塊自重、預力上拱、工作車移除、閉合與連續鋼腱、鋪面荷重，以及多年的潛變與乾縮。日照使頂板比底板熱，懸臂端會在白天上翹、夜間回落，所以測量與閉合都安排在溫度穩定的清晨。閉合時先以鋼支撐或型鋼骨架把兩懸臂端鎖住，再於一天最低溫時澆置閉合段，使混凝土硬化時兩端不再相對移動。~Each segment's casting elevation is the final profile plus a camber that offsets every later deformation: the weight of later segments, prestress uplift, traveler removal, closure and continuity tendons, surfacing loads, and years of creep and shrinkage. Sun heats the top slab more than the bottom, so cantilever tips rise by day and drop at night; survey and closure are therefore scheduled in the stable early morning. At closure, steel struts or a stiff skeleton first lock the two tips together, and the closure segment is cast at the day's lowest temperature so the tips no longer move relative to each other while the concrete hardens.
units.model: 線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C、頂底溫差 ΔT = 10°C、平均梁深 h = 5 m、L = 75 m：κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m，δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm。中午測量若不修正，閉合高程可差數公分。數值為教學假設。~A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, a top-to-bottom difference ΔT = 10°C, average depth h = 5 m and L = 75 m, κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m and δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm. An uncorrected noon survey can therefore miss the closure level by several centimetres. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段；鎖定支撐安裝後確認兩端高差在允差內（例如 ±10 mm），閉合段澆置後追蹤試體強度，達標才張拉連續鋼腱並拆除臨時固結。~Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement; after installing the locking struts confirm the level difference is within tolerance, for example ±10 mm; after casting, track cylinder strength and only then stress continuity tendons and release temporary fixity.
units.failure: 若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。~Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it; underestimating creep in the camber makes the midspan sag year after year into a visible dip that harms ride quality and drainage.
units.misconception: 只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。~Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
units.practice: 閉合程序書須包含鎖定支撐設計、溫度與時段條件、澆置與養護計畫、連續鋼腱張拉順序及臨時固結拆除順序，由設計與監造雙方簽認後才可執行。~The closure procedure must include the locking-strut design, temperature and time-window conditions, casting and curing plan, continuity-stressing order and the sequence for releasing temporary fixity, and be signed by both designer and supervising engineer before execution.

units.anchor: 懸臂端測量控制點~Survey points at cantilever tips
units.title: 線形測量與預拱回饋控制~Geometry survey and camber feedback
units.mechanism: 線形控制是一個回饋迴路：每一節塊在澆置前、澆置後、張拉後與工作車前移後都要量測端點高程，與預測撓度曲線比較，若偏差超出門檻，就修正後續節塊的澆置高程與模型參數（例如彈性模數、潛變係數、工作車勁度）。預鑄節塊的回饋則發生在預製場：每一節塊的匹配澆注幾何都要量測，因為一個微小的轉角誤差會沿懸臂放大。測量點需固定於節塊頂板並在全程保留。~Geometry control is a feedback loop: each segment tip is surveyed before casting, after casting, after stressing and after the traveler moves, and compared with the predicted deflection curve; if the deviation exceeds a threshold, later casting elevations and model parameters such as elastic modulus, creep coefficient and traveler stiffness are revised. For precast segments the feedback happens in the casting yard: the match-cast geometry of every segment is surveyed, because a tiny angular error is amplified along the cantilever. Survey points are fixed in the top slab and kept for the whole job.
units.model: 角度誤差沿懸臂放大：δ_tip = θ·L。若柱頭段或某一匹配接縫的轉角誤差 θ = 0.0005 rad（每 4 m 節塊約 2 mm），在其後 69 m 懸臂端造成 δ = 0.0005×69 ≈ 34.5 mm 的高程誤差，已超過常見閉合允差。數值為教學假設。~Angular error grows along the cantilever: δ_tip = θ·L. A rotation error θ = 0.0005 rad at the pier table or at one match-cast joint (about 2 mm over a 4 m segment) produces δ = 0.0005×69 ≈ 34.5 mm at a tip 69 m away, more than a typical closure tolerance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以精密水準儀與全站儀在固定時段（清晨）量測，每次記錄溫度並與前次比對；建立「預測—實測—修正」表，每一節塊的偏差與修正量由線形控制工程師簽名；預製場以控制線與測量塔每節塊量測匹配幾何，並計算累積轉角誤差。~Survey with a precise level and total station at a fixed early-morning time, logging temperature and comparing with the previous set; keep a predicted–measured–corrected table in which the geometry-control engineer signs each segment's deviation and correction; in the casting yard, measure match-cast geometry for every segment from control lines and survey towers and compute the cumulative angular error.
units.failure: 測量點被覆蓋或移位而未發現，後續節塊依錯誤基準修正，閉合時兩端高差過大，只能以額外的頂升、配重或閉合段變形吸收，造成殘餘應力與線形折角。~A survey point that is buried or disturbed without anyone noticing makes later segments correct against a false datum, so the tips miss each other at closure and the gap must be absorbed by jacking, ballast or a distorted closure segment, leaving residual stress and a kink in the profile.
units.misconception: 線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。~Geometry errors can all be corrected at once at closure.
units.practice: 指定專職線形控制工程師，並在每節塊澆置前發出經簽認的模板高程單；預測模型的參數每完成數個節塊就以實測值重新校正，修正紀錄納入竣工資料。~Appoint a dedicated geometry-control engineer who issues a signed form-level sheet before every segment is cast; recalibrate the prediction model with measured data every few segments and include the correction history in the as-built records.

units.anchor: 張拉伸長量紀錄~Stressing elongation records
units.title: 摩擦損失與伸長量驗證~Friction losses and elongation checks
units.mechanism: 鋼腱在孔道內張拉時，因曲率與孔道擺動產生摩擦，力量沿長度遞減；千斤頂讀到的是張拉端力，而真正留在箱梁中的是沿程平均力。工地無法直接量鋼腱內力，所以以伸長量作為獨立的第二個量測：若實測伸長量明顯小於計算值，代表摩擦比假設大或孔道受阻；若明顯偏大，則可能有滑絲或量測錯誤。兩者都必須在灌漿前查明，因為灌漿後就無法再處理。~When a tendon is stressed in its duct, curvature and wobble cause friction so force decreases along the length; the jack reads the force at the stressing end, while what the girder keeps is the average force along the tendon. The site cannot measure tendon force directly, so elongation is the independent second measurement: an elongation well below calculation means more friction than assumed or a blocked duct, one well above may mean strand slip or a measuring error. Either must be resolved before grouting, because afterwards nothing can be done.
units.model: P(x) = P₀·e^−(μα + kx)。P₀ = 3,711 kN、μ = 0.20、轉角 α = 0.35 rad、k = 0.0007 /m、長度 60 m：錨固端 P = 3,711×e^−0.112 ≈ 3,318 kN；平均力係數 (1 − e^−0.112)/0.112 ≈ 0.947，伸長量 ΔL = 0.947×3,711×60,000/(2,660×195) ≈ 406 mm。數值為教學假設。~P(x) = P₀·e^−(μα + kx). With P₀ = 3,711 kN, μ = 0.20, angle α = 0.35 rad, k = 0.0007 /m and length 60 m, the dead-end force is P = 3,711×e^−0.112 ≈ 3,318 kN; the average-force factor (1 − e^−0.112)/0.112 ≈ 0.947 gives elongation ΔL = 0.947×3,711×60,000/(2,660×195) ≈ 406 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 千斤頂與壓力錶須有效校正並成套使用；張拉時分級記錄壓力與伸長量，扣除初始鬆弛段與錨具回縮，與計算伸長量比較，偏差超出規範允差（常見為 ±5% 至 ±7%）即停止並通報設計單位；初期數束可做摩擦試驗反算 μ 與 k。~Jacks and gauges must be calibrated and used as matched sets; record pressure and elongation in increments, correct for initial slack and anchor set, and compare with the calculated elongation, stopping and notifying the designer if the deviation exceeds the specified tolerance, commonly ±5% to ±7%; friction tests on the first tendons can back-calculate μ and k.
units.failure: 孔道在澆置時被壓扁或漏漿堵塞，鋼腱伸長量偏小卻被當作量測誤差放行，結果有效預力不足，懸臂端下撓超出預測，頂板在營運期開裂。~A duct crushed or blocked by grout leakage during casting gives short elongation that is waved through as a measuring error; the effective prestress is then deficient, the tip deflects more than predicted, and the top slab cracks in service.
units.misconception: 千斤頂壓力達到設計值，就代表鋼腱整段都有設計預力。~If the jack reaches the design pressure, the whole tendon carries the design prestress.
units.practice: 張拉紀錄表需包含千斤頂編號、校正日期、各級壓力與伸長量、錨具回縮量與計算值，由張拉技術人員與監造雙簽；任何超出允差的鋼腱在灌漿前必須有書面處置決定。~The stressing record must include jack number, calibration date, pressure and elongation at each step, anchor set and the calculated value, signed by both the stressing technician and the supervising engineer; any tendon outside tolerance needs a written decision before grouting.

units.anchor: 跨中長期下垂~Long-term midspan sag
units.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度~Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection
units.mechanism: 平衡懸臂橋在閉合前是靜定懸臂，閉合後成為連續梁，混凝土潛變會讓結構逐漸往「一次整體澆築」的內力狀態重分配，跨中正彎矩增加。同時鋼腱鬆弛、混凝土乾縮與潛變造成預力損失，使跨中持續下垂。長跨箱梁對這些參數極為敏感：1977 年完工的 Koror–Babeldaob 橋主跨約 241 m，跨中設鉸，約 16 年後懸臂端下撓超過約 1.2 m；1996 年 7 月完成封閉中鉸並加設連續體外預力的補強，同年 9 月倒塌，鑑定調查認為頂板分層剝離觸發破壞，成為長期撓度與補強評估的經典教訓。~Before closure a balanced-cantilever bridge is a statically determinate cantilever; after closure it is continuous, and creep gradually redistributes moments towards the state of a girder cast in one piece, increasing midspan sagging moment. Strand relaxation, shrinkage and creep also reduce prestress, so the midspan keeps sagging. Long-span boxes are very sensitive to these parameters: the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge, completed in 1977 with a main span of about 241 m and a midspan hinge, had cantilever tips that deflected more than about 1.2 m after some 16 years; a retrofit finished in July 1996 closed the hinge and added continuous external tendons, and the bridge collapsed that September, with the forensic investigation pointing to delamination of the top flange as the trigger, a classic lesson in long-term deflection and retrofit assessment.
units.model: 長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。跨中彈性撓度 δ_el = 60 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm；若實際 φ = 2.5，δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm，多出 30 mm，預拱若以 φ = 2.0 設定就會殘留下垂。數值為教學假設。~Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ). With an elastic midspan deflection δ_el = 60 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm; if the real φ is 2.5, δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm, 30 mm more, so a camber set for φ = 2.0 leaves a residual sag. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限；完工後建立跨中與四分點高程的固定測量點，定期在相同溫度條件下量測，與預測曲線比較，偏離趨勢持續擴大時啟動結構評估。~At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection; after completion set permanent level points at midspan and quarter points and survey them periodically under similar temperatures, triggering a structural assessment if the deviation from prediction keeps growing.
units.failure: 只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大；若補強時未充分理解既有預力與潛變狀態，新增荷重或改變結構系統可能觸發突然破壞。~Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade; a retrofit made without understanding the existing prestress and creep state can add load or change the structural system and trigger sudden failure.
units.misconception: 混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。~Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing.
units.practice: 竣工資料必須保存施工期線形紀錄、預拱值與長期撓度預測曲線；任何長期下垂或補強工程前，先由獨立的結構工程師以實測資料重新評估，並將評估結論列為施工許可的前提。~As-built records must keep the construction geometry log, camber values and the predicted long-term deflection curve; before any sag remedy or retrofit, an independent structural engineer re-assesses the bridge with measured data, and that assessment is a precondition for the works permit.

units.anchor: 備用預力孔道~Spare post-tensioning ducts
units.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接~Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover
units.mechanism: 平衡懸臂橋的長期性能取決於預力系統是否完整：體內鋼腱靠灌漿保護，難以直接檢查，因此要靠箱內檢查、裂縫圖、撓度紀錄與非破壞檢測（例如透地雷達或磁漏檢測）間接判斷。現代規範要求預留備用孔道、錨碇與轉向塊，讓日後可以加裝體外鋼腱補償預力損失或增加載重能力；箱梁內部也需有照明、通風、排水與通行門，使檢查人員能沿全長走動。~The long-term performance of a balanced-cantilever bridge depends on the integrity of its prestress: internal tendons are protected by grout and hard to inspect, so their condition is judged indirectly through inspections inside the box, crack maps, deflection records and non-destructive methods such as ground-penetrating radar or magnetic flux leakage. Modern provisions call for spare ducts, anchorages and deviators so that external tendons can later be added to make up for losses or increase capacity, and the box interior needs lighting, ventilation, drainage and access doors so inspectors can walk its full length.
units.model: 若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。數值為教學假設。~If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN; at 3,200 kN per tendon that is 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 tendons, i.e. two spare anchorages and ducts on each side of the pier. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前做一次完整基準檢查：箱內裂縫圖與寬度、錨頭保護蓋狀態、灌漿孔與排氣孔封閉、跨中與墩頂高程、伸縮縫間隙，所有結果附照片與座標存入養護資料庫；之後每次定期檢查都與此基準比較，裂縫寬度或撓度增量超過門檻即啟動詳細評估。~Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database; compare every later routine inspection with this baseline and trigger a detailed assessment if crack widths or deflection increments exceed thresholds.
units.failure: 箱梁排水孔堵塞讓雨水積存在底板，沿錨碇與孔道滲入，鋼絞線多年後腐蝕斷裂，等到外觀出現縱向裂縫時損傷已大；若未預留補強錨碇，日後補強只能在既有箱梁上鑽孔植筋，風險與成本都高。~Blocked box drains let rainwater pond on the bottom slab and seep along anchorages and ducts, corroding strands until they break years later, by which time visible longitudinal cracks show heavy damage; without spare anchorages, later strengthening needs drilling and doweling into the existing box, with high risk and cost.
units.misconception: 預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。~The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.
units.practice: 交接文件應包括施工階段分析、鋼腱張拉與灌漿紀錄、線形控制歷程、備用孔道位置圖、箱內檢查路線與安全進入程序；管理單位應排定首次詳細檢查並保存原始量測資料。~Handover documents should include the construction-stage analysis, stressing and grouting records, the geometry-control history, the spare-duct location plan, inspection routes inside the box and confined-space entry procedures; the owner should schedule the first detailed inspection and keep the raw survey data.

example: 設計練習：一座 150 m 主跨的場鑄平衡懸臂箱梁，計算第 10 號節塊端點的澆置預拱。預測各項撓度（向下為負）：本節塊與後續節塊自重 −45 mm、懸臂鋼腱上拱 +20 mm、長期潛變與乾縮 −30 mm、閉合與連續鋼腱 +6 mm、鋪面與護欄 −12 mm，合計 −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm，所以節塊須澆在完工高程之上 61 mm。工作車在濕混凝土下另下撓 8 mm，因此模板應設在完工高程之上 61 + 8 = 69 mm。若實際潛變係數比假設大 25%，潛變項變為 −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm，總預拱變為 68.5 mm，模板須設在 76.5 mm；若仍以 69 mm 澆置，該點長期約低 7.5 mm。這說明潛變參數的不確定性為何要在設計時做敏感度分析並在施工中回饋修正。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: for a 150 m cast-in-place balanced-cantilever box girder, compute the casting camber at the tip of segment 10. Predicted deflections (downward negative): self-weight of this and later segments −45 mm, cantilever prestress uplift +20 mm, long-term creep and shrinkage −30 mm, closure and continuity tendons +6 mm, surfacing and barriers −12 mm, totalling −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm, so the segment must be cast 61 mm above the final profile. The traveler deflects another 8 mm under wet concrete, so the forms are set 61 + 8 = 69 mm above the final profile. If the real creep coefficient is 25% higher than assumed, the creep term becomes −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm, the total camber 68.5 mm and the form setting 76.5 mm; casting at 69 mm would leave that point about 7.5 mm low in the long term. This shows why creep uncertainty needs a design sensitivity study and feedback correction during construction. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 德國 Dyckerhoff & Widmann 公司的 Ulrich Finsterwalder 結合預力鋼棒與懸臂施工，1951 年完成跨度 62 m 的 Balduinstein 蘭河橋，被視為第一座以懸臂工法建造的預力混凝土橋；1965 年完工的 Bendorf 萊茵河橋主跨 208 m，把場鑄平衡懸臂推向大跨度。法國 Campenon Bernard 公司 1962 年在 Choisy-le-Roi 橋首度大規模商業應用預鑄節塊，Jean Muller 隨後發展匹配澆注與節塊架設設備。1998 年挪威 Stolma 橋以約 301 m 主跨創下紀錄，而 1996 年 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的倒塌則提醒工程界長期撓度與補強評估的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Ulrich Finsterwalder of Dyckerhoff & Widmann combined prestressing bars with cantilever construction; the 62 m Balduinstein bridge over the Lahn, finished in 1951, is regarded as the first prestressed concrete bridge built by the free-cantilever method, and the Bendorf Rhine bridge, completed in 1965 with a 208 m main span, pushed cast-in-place balanced cantilevering to long spans. Campenon Bernard made the first major commercial use of precast segments at Choisy-le-Roi in 1962, and Jean Muller went on to develop match casting and segment-erection equipment. Norway's Stolma Bridge set a record main span of about 301 m in 1998, while the 1996 collapse of the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge reminded the profession of the importance of long-term deflection and retrofit assessment. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Balduinstein 蘭河橋單跨 62 m，1951 年完工，為第一座懸臂工法預力混凝土橋~The Balduinstein bridge over the Lahn has a single 62 m span and was completed in 1951 as the first free-cantilever prestressed concrete bridge
Bendorf 萊茵河橋主跨 208 m，1965 年完工，梁深由約 4.40 m 變化至 10.45 m~The Bendorf Rhine bridge has a 208 m main span, completed in 1965, with girder depth varying from about 4.40 m to 10.45 m
挪威 Stolma 橋主跨 301 m，1998 年以平衡懸臂工法完工~Norway's Stolma Bridge has a 301 m main span and was completed in 1998 by balanced cantilevering

Koror–Babeldaob 橋主跨約 241 m（790 ft），1977 年完工，約 16 年後懸臂下撓超過約 1.2 m，1996 年 9 月倒塌~The Koror–Babeldaob Bridge had an about 241 m (790 ft) main span, opened in 1977, sagged more than about 1.2 m after some 16 years and collapsed in September 1996
重慶石板坡長江大橋主跨 330 m，跨中 103 m、約 1,325 t 鋼箱梁於 2006 年吊裝~Chongqing's Shibanpo Yangtze bridge has a 330 m main span; its 103 m, about 1,325 t steel midspan box was lifted in 2006

ASBI 指出預鑄平衡懸臂經濟跨度約 160 至 500 ft（約 50 至 150 m），場鑄懸臂在美國用到約 760 ft~ASBI gives about 160 to 500 ft (about 50 to 150 m) as the economic span for precast balanced cantilever, with cast-in-place cantilevers used up to about 760 ft in the US
Choisy-le-Roi 橋 1962 年的預鑄節塊長約 2.50 m、重約 25 t~The 1962 Choisy-le-Roi bridge used precast segments about 2.50 m long weighing about 25 t
場鑄平衡懸臂常用節塊長約 3 至 5 m，每對節塊循環約 1 週~Cast-in-place balanced cantilevers commonly use segments about 3 to 5 m long with a cycle of about 1 week per segment pair
